rv.q: Here physicality is paired with a contemporary, empathic wit and sensitivity, which stops a potentially mawkish story from ever becoming too saccharine.
Thoughtful, inventive and quietly shattering, Lost Atom's most striking achievement is its insistence that love is shaped not only by what happened, but by what we choose to remember.
It's all very human, relatable, and easy to commiserate.
Lost Atoms is at once as daring as it is traditional, as willing to push boundaries as it is to work within them.
